resources.string: Nano stores your least recently used static prompts. Would you like to clear this cache now?
Gemini Nano isn\'t available on this device
This app is a playground for Gemini Nano, Google\'s on-device AI model. Your phone doesn\'t currently provide Gemini Nano through Android AICore, so prompts can\'t be run here.
Gemini Nano is provided by the Android AICore system app. Make sure Android AICore and Private Compute Services are installed and up to date, then check again.
Android AICore reported a problem while preparing Gemini Nano. Updating AICore and checking again usually fixes this.
A supported phone, such as the Pixel 9 / Pixel 10 series, Galaxy S26 series and other recent flagships
Android 13 or later with Android AICore and Private Compute Services up to date
An internet connection for the one-time model download
